$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Decoded dimensions that do not exactly match the header are rejected

rejection.rule: The phone verifies decoded width and height exactly match the header. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2, §2)
rejection.effect: The phone does not render the image, retains unrelated coaching lanes, shows a transient transfer error, and sends protocol_error_v2 invalid_message. The desktop commits the visual job to failed with fresh Retry/Dismiss.

summary: An available artifact is announced with a header declaring 768x1024, but the payload decodes to 100x100. The dimension mismatch is a current-job byte failure.

steps.note: Accepted sessionId and the visual bundle. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

visualGuidance.demonstrates: Move the subject one step left

artifact.demonstrates: Move the subject one step left
